detail: 11px of text in a 1px box
acknowledged_because: WordPress's visually-hidden pattern: a 1px clipped box that keeps the text in the accessibility tree while hiding it from sight. Being clipped is the whole mechanism, not a defect - the audit is right that 11px of text sits in a 1px box, and that is exactly what a screen reader needs it to do.
